dims_mm.note: d_max derived: 22 mm body + 17.5 mm battery pack (vendor gives no combined figure)

weight_g.note: Vendor: about 799 g with controllers and without battery (standard version; Liquid Cooling version +70 g). handheld.stated = 799 g + vendor 381 g battery.

screen.note: 30-144 Hz VRR; 700 nits HBM, 1100 nits HDR; 100% DCI-P3

battery.note: Blade-style snap-on pack with built-in kickstand, about 381 g; also works over a cable. 240 W GaN charger via the DC jack; 55 W max TDP on battery or USB power.

controls.stick_note: Capacitive joysticks, 9 mm height, 22 degree tilt, RGB
controls.note: Dual-stage triggers with physical travel switch; hot-swappable 8/4-way D-pad; controller connector base (1,100 mAh, 99 g) sold with early configurations

cooling: Dual 5400 RPM fans, 4 copper heat pipes, 47,200 mm2 fins; 80 W air-cooled; Liquid Cooling version up to 120 W with the Frost Bay unit
notes: Teased in April 2026 as the X2 Mini with a Ryzen AI Max+ 395; it launched with the Max+ 388 instead, so there is no 395 row. Indiegogo from 2026-06-15 ($2,466 and up; VideoCardz quoted $2,399). Store list price $2,699, sale price $2,499 at crawl time. Brief said 'shipped June 2026'; sources show Indiegogo in June and shipping from late July 2026.
